description: This file contains extension methods for handling Azure Storage request failure exceptions, primarily for checking specific HTTP status codes and error codes related to blob storage.

classes.name: StorageExceptionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for handling Azure Storage request failure exceptions.

methods.name: IsNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Not Found' HTTP status.

methods.name: IsPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Precondition Failed' HTTP status.

methods.name: IsConflict
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Conflict' HTTP status.

methods.name: IsContainerNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates the container was not found.

methods.name: IsBlobNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates the blob was not found.
